scripts.dev: concurrently --names "client,server" --prefix-colors "cyan.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w backend
scripts.start: concurrently --names "client,server" --prefix-colors "cyan.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run preview -w client" "npm run start -w backend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w backend
